mechanism: Sulfasalazine may reduce the absorption of lisdexamfetamine through delayed gastric transit and altered intestinal pH, while lisdexamfetamine's sympathomimetic effects may exacerbate GI symptoms in patients taking sulfasalazine for inflammatory bowel disease.
action: Monitor therapeutic efficacy of lisdexamfetamine and consider dose adjustments; separate dosing by 2+ hours if possible, and observe for reduced ADHD symptom control or GI symptom worsening.
